Rashi on Nedarim 20b:11:1.hebrew: יששכר חמור גרם - חמור גרם ליששכר שנולד, אותו חמור שהיה יעקב רוכב, שפנה לאהל לאה:
Rashi on Nedarim 20b:11:1.english: Issachar is a large-boned donkey - A donkey caused Issachar to be born — [namely,] that donkey on which Jacob was riding, which turned toward Leah's tent.

Rashi on Nedarim 20b:12:1.hebrew: דמרציא ארצויי - אינה תובעת בפה, אלא דמרציא קמיה — מראה לו מתוך דבריה — כגון לאה, דמההיא נפקי בני מעליא:
Rashi on Nedarim 20b:12:1.english: Who entices - She does not demand [intercourse] explicitly, but rather endears herself before him — showing him [her desire] through her words, like Leah — for from such [a woman] come forth virtuous children.

Rashi on Nedarim 20b:14:1.hebrew: ארבעה נדרים התירו חכמי' - בלא שום שאלה:
Rashi on Nedarim 20b:14:1.english: The Sages permitted four [types of] vows - without any inquiry [to a sage].

Rashi on Nedarim 20b:14:2.english: Vows of exhortation, etc., than a sela - Which is four dinars.

Rashi on Nedarim 20b:14:3.hebrew: והלה - הקונה, אומר שאינו מוסיף לו על שקל, שהוא שני דינרין:
Rashi on Nedarim 20b:14:3.english: And the other one - The buyer says that he will not add for him above a shekel, which is two dinars.

Rashi on Nedarim 20b:1:1.english: He does not converse - He does not engage in marital relations.

Rashi on Nedarim 20b:1:2.english: He reveals a handbreadth - Of her garment.

Rashi on Nedarim 20b:1:3.hebrew: ומכסה - אותו טפח מבגד, וכן עושה עד שיבא עליה:
Rashi on Nedarim 20b:1:3.english: And covers - that handbreadth of [her] garment, and so he does until he has relations with her.

Rashi on Nedarim 20b:1:4.hebrew: ודומה כמי שכפאו שד - שבא אליה בכח, ודומה כמי ששד כפאו. ואית דאמרי: שמתכסה כולו כאדם שמפחד מן השד:
Rashi on Nedarim 20b:1:4.english: And he appears like one whom a demon has coerced - [Meaning] that he comes upon her with force, and appears like one whom a demon has coerced. And some say: that he covers himself completely, like a person who is afraid of a demon.

Rashi on Nedarim 20b:5:1.english: That they are distinguished - For they are wrapped in tzitzit.

Rashi on Nedarim 20b:6:1.english: Binnita - A fish that one can eat however he wishes.

Rashi on Nedarim 20b:8:1.english: Children of Asnat Meshaga'ach - It is a mnemonic.

Rashi on Nedarim 20b:9:1.hebrew: שנואה - שלבו על אחרת בשעת תשמיש. ואמרו: כשבא עליה, לאו ביאה גמורה היא, הואיל וכל כך שונאה, אלא כזנות בעלמא הוא:
Rashi on Nedarim 20b:9:1.english: A hated woman - Whose [husband's] heart is on another [woman] at the time of intercourse. And [the Sages] said: When he has intercourse with her, it is not a complete act of intercourse, since he hates her so much; rather, it is like mere promiscuity.

Rashi on Nedarim 20b:9:2.english: Children of ostracism - That the husband is under ostracism, and he has relations with her, and she conceives from him.

Rashi on Nedarim 20b:9:3.hebrew: בגי תמורה - שיש לו ב' נשים, וכסבור לבא על זו ובא על אחרת. ל"א: בני תמורה, שהוא סבור לבא על אשה אחרת ונמצאת שהיא אשתי, וקרובין לממזרות, שהרי נתכוון לניאוף:
Rashi on Nedarim 20b:9:3.english: Children of substitution - Where [a man] has two wives, and he intends to have intercourse with this one and [instead] has intercourse with the other. Another interpretation: "Children of substitution" — where he intends to have intercourse with another woman and she turns out to be his wife; and [the resulting children] are close to [being] mamzerim, since he intended [to commit] adultery.

Rashi on Nedarim 20b:9:4.english: Children of strife - [One] who engages in marital relations during strife.

Rashi on Nedarim 20b:9:5.hebrew: בני שכרות - שמשמש בשכרות, דביאתו לאו ביאה גמורה, אלא כביאת זנות היא, שאין מתכוון אלא לבעול בעלמא:
Rashi on Nedarim 20b:9:5.english: Children of drunkenness - [This refers to one] who engages in marital relations while drunk, for his intercourse is not complete [marital] intercourse, but rather is like licentious intercourse, since he intends nothing other than merely to have intercourse.

Rashi on Nedarim 20b:9:6.hebrew: בני ערבוביא - שבא על אשה אחת בין הנשים, ואין ידוע על איזו מהן בא. ל"א: שבאו עליה אנשים הרבה, ואין ידוע בן מי הוא. ל"א: בני ערבוביא, ספק בן תשעה לראשון או בן שבעה לאחרון:
Rashi on Nedarim 20b:9:6.english: Children of mixture - [This refers to one] who had intercourse with one woman among [several] women, and it is not known with which of them he had intercourse. Another explanation: [It refers to a woman] with whom many men had intercourse, and it is not known whose son he is. Another explanation: "Children of mixture" — [a child regarding whom there is] a doubt [whether he is] a nine-month [child] of the first [husband] or a seven-month [child] of the latter [husband].

Tosafot on Nedarim 20b:14:1.hebrew: ארבעה נדרים - עד השתא איירי בכינויי האסורין ובכינויי המותרים, במתפיס בדבר הנדור ובמתפיס בדבר המותר; והשתא מיירי בנדרים, דאע"ג דהוציאם מפיו בלשון שאר נדר — אפילו הכי מותרין. וטעמא הוי משום דבעינן פיו ולבו שוין, ואנן סהדי דלא שוו פיו ולבו בהני ד' נדרים. והיינו טעמא דלא פריך בגמרא: "והא דברים שבלב", כדפריך לקמן אנדרי אונסין — משום דבעינן פיו ולבו שוין, ונדרי זירוזין שריין מהאי טעמא:
Tosafot on Nedarim 20b:14:1.english: Four vows - Until now, [the Mishnah] dealt with substitutes for [vow] prohibitions and substitutes for permitted things, [and] with associating [a vow] with a vowed item and associating [a vow] with a permitted item; and now it deals with vows where, even though one uttered them from his mouth in the language of any other vow, even so they are permitted. And the reason is because we require his mouth and his heart to be equal, and we are witnesses [i.e., it is self-evident] that his mouth and his heart are not equal in these four vows. And this is the reason that the Gemara does not ask, "But these are matters in the heart," as it asks later regarding vows [impeded by] circumstances beyond one's control — because we require his mouth and his heart to be equal, and vows of exhortation are permitted for this reason.

Tosafot on Nedarim 20b:14:2.hebrew: נדרי הבאי - גוזמא, והבאי לשון אחרים:
Tosafot on Nedarim 20b:14:2.english: Vows of exaggeration (nidrei havai) - Exaggeration, and havai is another expression [for it].

Tosafot on Nedarim 20b:14:3.hebrew: ארבעה נדרים - עד השתא איירי בכינויי האסורין ובכינויי המותרים, במתפיס בדבר הנדור ובמתפיס בדבר המותר; והשתא מיירי בנדרים דאע"ג דהוציאם מפיו בלשון שאר נדר, אפילו הכי מותרין. וטעמא הוי משום דבעינן פיו ולבו שוין, ואנן סהדי דלא שוו פיו ולבו בהני ד' נדרים. והיינו טעמא דלא פריך בגמרא: "והא דברים שבלב", כדפריך לקמן אנדרי אונסין — משום דבעינן פיו ולבו שוין, ונדרי זירוזין שריין מהאי טעמא:
Tosafot on Nedarim 20b:14:3.english: Four vows - Until now, [the Mishnah] dealt with forbidden substitutes [for vows] and permitted substitutes, [and] with associating [an object] with a vowed item and associating [it] with a permitted item; and now it deals with vows that even though he uttered them with his mouth using the phrasing of an ordinary vow, they are nevertheless permitted. And the reason is because we require his mouth and his heart to be in agreement, and we are witnesses [i.e., it is obvious] that his mouth and his heart are not in agreement in these four vows. And this is the reason why the Gemara does not ask, "But these are matters of the heart!" as it asks later regarding vows [of] circumstances beyond one's control — because we require his mouth and his heart to be in agreement, and vows of exhortation are permitted for this reason:
